title: salutepy: biometeorological indices and the Meteosalute processing chain in Python

creators.name: Crisci, Alfonso
creators.affiliation: Institute of BioEconomy, National Research Council of Italy (CNR-IBE), Florence, Italy

description:
salutepy computes human biometeorological and occupational heat-stress indices (UTCI, PET, WBGT in sun and shade, PMV and clothing insulation, Steadman apparent temperature, NET, THI, heat index, humidex, wind chill, work-time loss) on gridded weather data (GRIB, NetCDF, GeoTIFF) and on arrays, with compiled parallel kernels for the iterative models.

It is the Python version of the Meteosalute forecasting chain of the Institute of BioEconomy of the Italian National Research Council (CNR-IBE, Florence): it reproduces the operational hourly NetCDF products from MOLOCH GRIB2 runs and can also compute the indices from GeoTIFF rasters without date and time. The ports were validated against biometeo.js/rBiometeo, the R package HeatStress and the operational Meteosalute products.

Italiano: libreria Python per il calcolo di indici biometeorologici e di stress termico lavorativo su dati in griglia; versione Python della catena di previsione Meteosalute del CNR-IBE.
